name: toneline
description: One call locate ticket handling for underground facility operators

scripts.capacity: node bin/toneline.js capacity -c examples/cross-timbers.json -f examples/march-2024.feed -r examples/roster.json
scripts.month: node bin/toneline.js month -c examples/cross-timbers.json -f examples/march-2024.feed -p 2024-03 -a 2024-03-20T08:00 -d examples/damages-2024.csv
scripts.respond: node bin/toneline.js respond -c examples/cross-timbers.json -f examples/march-2024.feed -a 2024-03-14T08:00 -b desk
